explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/368: 'Schinzel [Sc67b] observed that for infinitely many n we have F(n) ≤ n^{O(1/log log log n)}.' The Lean statement is the weaker consequence: for every δ > 0 there are infinitely many n with F n ≤ n^δ, which follows since the exponent O(1/log log log n) tends to 0. Correctly derived and documented as a consequence. Faithful.
